statement.p: Find area of the region under the curve y = x^3 - 4 and above the x-axis, for 3 \le x \le 6.

static.solution:
(Click on the graph for a larger version.)
The area we want is that above the x-axis and under the function, for 3 \le x \le 6. Thus we need to find \int_{3}^{6} ( x^3 - 4) dx \approx 291.75. We can find the area in a number of ways, the easiest of which is to use a graphing calculator.
